description: Eight XLSX files contain time, pressure and turbidity observations from eight trials covering 18 hydraulic profiles in Sheffield's experimental pipe loop. This resource is provided by Paul Husband; Joby B. Boxall; Reinar Lokk. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The publication defines sensor positions and spreadsheet naming. One experimental campaign is represented. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
